configuration.transaction_scope: one transaction around all insert statements in a configuration sample

methodology.statement_order: Configuration order is shuffled deterministically each round with a fixed recorded seed; each configuration has its own 3 warmups and 20 measured samples.
methodology.timed_execute: Per-statement time from immediately before conn.execute() through its return, which includes conversion, protocol, server, and response reception. fetchall and ID list extension are outside this timer but within transaction_total.
methodology.conversion_instrumentation: TimedCursor overrides Psycopg Cursor._convert_query only to time super()._convert_query during ordinary execute calls. This directly measures Psycopg's actual query-conversion stage (SQL placeholder conversion plus adaptation) while adding a small Python timing wrapper.
methodology.adaptation: Separate Transformer and PostgresQuery probes distinguish parameter serialization from complete Psycopg query conversion. Standalone Transformer time is partial and not equivalent to total driver time.
methodology.server_timing: Prior EXPLAIN ANALYZE results are retained as evidence but do not include all server parsing/binding work or normal RETURNING transfer.
methodology.protocol: libpq PQtrace is enabled for isolated synthetic insert probes. Only parsed message counts/length fields are saved; raw trace text is discarded. This is diagnostic tracing and is not part of latency samples. Server logging settings are read, not modified.
methodology.memory: Python tracemalloc runs are separate from latency runs and do not include native libpq memory or PostgreSQL backend memory.
methodology.cleanup: TRUNCATE and row count verification are outside timed sections. Every variant checks complete unique IDs and persisted row count.

psycopg_query_cache_limits.source_behavior: Psycopg avoids caching query placeholder parsing when either limit is exceeded.

query_conversion_batches.note: PostgresQuery.convert() is the exact conversion method called by Cursor.execute(), measured separately. Its timing includes SQL placeholder conversion and Psycopg adaptation but not socket/protocol exchange. Private Psycopg 3.3.9 internals are used for stage detail.
